meta.note: Read from the local checkout, then rebranded: the three schemes (Warm, Dark, Slate) become two themes (Light, Dark) built on aubergine, marigold and a sage/fern/leaf green ramp; Rubik + Manrope; new logo. Old to new mapping lives in the Migration section.

tokens.name: brand-aubergine
tokens.usage: The brand's one dark. Logo tile, wordmark, light-mode primary and eyebrow. Never a text color in Dark (1.25:1 on night).

tokens.name: brand-aubergine-lift
tokens.usage: Aubergine lifted for dark grounds: dark-mode eyebrow pill and hero cards. Light text on it holds 9.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-marigold
tokens.usage: The brand's one bright. The roof, the lit 'today' cell, today and dark-mode actions. Always a fill with dark text on it (9.6:1); never text on a light ground (1.9:1).

tokens.name: brand-sage
tokens.usage: Soft garden green. Large calm fills: far-off countdown panels, attending guests.

tokens.name: brand-fern
tokens.usage: Mid green. The logo's diagonal cell, the 1-to-7-day countdown panel, time-scale edges. A graphic color (3.2:1 on linen, 4.2:1 on aubergine); only large text on it (white holds 3.45:1 at 24px+ or bold 19px+).

tokens.name: brand-leaf
tokens.usage: Deep green for text: 'coming up' dates and done checks in Light. 6.3:1 on the soon fill.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: The only alarm. Solid fill for overdue with white text (5.1:1).

tokens.name: brand-linen
tokens.usage: Light-mode ground, and the board inside the logo.

tokens.name: brand-night
tokens.usage: Dark-mode ground (aubergine-black), and text on marigold in Dark.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the main panel. Flat: no gradients.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The main rounded panel each screen sits in.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, day columns, 'later' tasks, buttons.

tokens.name: card-sunken
tokens.usage: Event chips inside day columns and month cells; neutral stat tiles.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, card, card-sunken and every soft time fill (11:1+ Light, 9.4:1+ Dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, meta, 'Nothing scheduled'. 4.8:1+ on every light fill, 5.7:1+ on every dark fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines on cards and panels. Decorative only.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Active nav tab, primary buttons, checkbox outlines, focus ring.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (11.9:1 Light, 9.6:1 Dark).

tokens.name: eyebrow-bg
tokens.usage: The screen-type pill, top-left of every display screen.

tokens.name: eyebrow-fg
tokens.usage: Icon and label in the eyebrow pill (7.7:1 Light, 5.8:1 Dark).

tokens.name: love
tokens.usage: Wedding and 'love' moments: the confirmed-guests number and Wedding pulse labels.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: time-overdue
tokens.usage: Overdue task card: solid fill. Loudest thing on any screen.

tokens.name: on-time-overdue
tokens.usage: All text and icons on an overdue card.

tokens.name: time-today
tokens.usage: Today: solid fill for the task card, day column, month cell, tonight's meal, the countdown panel on its day.

tokens.name: on-time-today
tokens.usage: All text and icons on a today fill, both themes (8.8:1).

tokens.name: time-soon
tokens.usage: Next 1-3 days: soft fill for tasks, day columns, month cells, meals.

tokens.name: time-soon-chip
tokens.usage: Event chips sitting on a soon column or cell. Green, not aubergine, in Dark so events never look punched through to the ground. Ink text (8.7:1+).

tokens.name: time-soon-edge
tokens.usage: 6px left edge (cards) or 5px top edge (columns, cells) on a soon fill. Decorative: the fill and the date text carry meaning.

tokens.name: time-soon-fg
tokens.usage: The date line on a soon card ('Wed · in 2 days').

tokens.name: time-week
tokens.usage: 4-7 days out: soft aubergine fill for tasks. Not used in the week view, where every column is already this week.

tokens.name: time-week-edge
tokens.usage: Left edge on a week card.

tokens.name: time-week-fg
tokens.usage: The date line on a week card.

tokens.name: countdown-soon
tokens.usage: Countdown panel 1-7 days out, both themes. Text on it is white at display sizes only (keep the date line bold 17px+).

tokens.name: countdown-later
tokens.usage: Countdown panel 8-30 days out. A muted green that still reads on night (ink holds 6:1). Also attending guest tiles.

tokens.name: countdown-far
tokens.usage: Countdown panel 31+ days out: neutral, so the photo and the number carry it and color builds as the day nears.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: The check in a just-completed task, during the celebration before it disappears.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive actions outside the time scale (form errors, 'incorrect' in the bonus round). Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner background, with ink or danger text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive score changes, 'correct' in the bonus round, attending counts.

tokens.name: person-blueberry
tokens.usage: Person color 1: dot + name text, calendar event bar. 5.6:1+ on every light fill.

tokens.name: person-berry
tokens.usage: Person color 2.

tokens.name: person-lagoon
tokens.usage: Person color 3.

tokens.name: person-clay
tokens.usage: Person color 4.

tokens.name: person-iris
tokens.usage: Person color 5.

tokens.name: person-olive
tokens.usage: Person color 6.

tokens.name: person-cocoa
tokens.usage: Person color 7.

tokens.name: person-moss
tokens.usage: Person color 8. Also the scorecard player palette: use person colors 1-6.

styles.name: countdown

styles.name: hero-number
styles.usage: Hero figures: confirmed guests, the clock.

styles.name: card-title

styles.name: task-title
styles.usage: To-do titles and event titles in the week view.

styles.name: body

styles.name: meta

styles.name: caption
